scenario.note: The rule that only allowed teams may work is removed by relaxing the team_pattern constraint, which enforces that only allowed teams are selected in each group.
Removing the team pattern and size constraints allows any worker-task assignment and any team selection, effectively removing the group team and size limits.
The team pattern constraint for worker_7 is removed, allowing worker_7 to work without being part of an allowed team.
The rule that only allowed teams may work is lifted for worker_1 and worker_10 only, allowing them to work outside their group's allowed team patterns.
